title: FROM IDEA TO IMPLEMENTATION: EVALUATING THE INFLUENCE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT - AN OPINION PAPER
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith/religion. Religion is mentioned once in passing as a potential type of inherited bias in LLMs, alongside gender stereotypes and racial prejudices.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the application of Large Language Models in software development.
